answer: One enforceable rule: sample three unrelated data feeds and require independent corroboration. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The kernel of work and the thread of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a nectar to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
